chunks.content: Acme Technologies was founded in 2018 in San Francisco. In fiscal year 2025, Acme reported an annual recurring revenue of $42.5 million. The company employs 150 engineers across three continents. Their flagship product is Readr, a deterministic document search engine. Acme raised a $12M Series A round led by Horizon Ventures.
